title: How to build a personal AI assistant that actually understands you

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "how" is clear—use open protocols like WebDAV and REST to build a flexible, interoperable AI assistant that truly learns from you.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "To" build understanding, you need neural embeddings and real-time NLP—protocols don’t capture the nuance of human language.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open protocols allow third-party tools and integrations, giving you full control and enabling continuous learning through APIs like GraphQL.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without a "to" focused on training models on personal data, your AI will never grasp your unique context or intent.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Understanding comes from training, not just protocols—without "to," you’re just building a hollow shell.
